The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration ordered robotaxi fixes after reports that vehicles interfered with first responders, increasing regulatory pressure on U.S. driverless fleets [NHTSA ordered robotaxi fixes](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-?oc=5). This occurs as Waymo and Tesla expand robotaxi services into additional cities, including Las Vegas and Miami [Waymo and Tesla continue robotaxi expansion](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxOaEFKTGprbnBqR1FoTXFKZnN2c1R5UXY5Mi02aTNxV1kwRWwzY2tlY0N3bUVlbklwV0E2ZGdGS1JIUzRhUkxWUzBQZWxzMDRHX0Z5QjZncWdZU3FldTVkZUN1ckR6cDBQMXI0TVM4TW1KVmp4WXlPbE1pTVdLU28xXzJOSGppUWIxQ3FmOFl2N01JdWZCU3hOTkVaVFVEQjZWTmUyS0xtc0hPek5n?oc=5).

Federal agencies are prioritizing drone defense and procurement. The Pentagon released a counter-drone handbook and is preparing to deploy a new counter-drone system [Pentagon releases new counter-drone handbook](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMie0FVX3lxTE45Skt3d1JaNFlkTUJhY0RQMVZnM2xqR21BR3c5TVFCUS1KbDZwbERlZjN5NEU3QzFwa1U4X2poT2JjY3l4Sl83VVI3X0gzTWZSYjZ6Z2ktRTd0LWRSWXRsRk9FdWJFbHhFMHlaTlpfVXZUNEd5WXlRR3QySQ?oc=5). Additionally, Neros won a $500 million U.S. Army drone contract for small UAS production [Neros wins a $500 million U.S. Army drone contract](https://news.google.?oc=5), while the Department of War finalized FY26 APFIT awards totaling over $2 billion [Department of War final FY26 APFIT awards](https://news.google.?oc=5).

Commercial drone and eVTOL operations continue to scale. BRINC raised $125 million to expand its public safety drone network and U.S. manufacturing [BRINC raises $125 million](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwgFBVV95cUxQS0FWV3lZdi16ZGltZVdpdC15cHZ5cl95cEh1OXRJcTNqQnFWeTJ3NVk5NUY0c1NtU3g5MkprLW9DUVYzX1lxVHpQUlpKdUNwenFGR2RQV3U2cjRHT01HNWp3dWRTZVNsSVhkTDZLN2c0aEF4TkNYSHFZTkh3YjZOSVlhZzdFLWxGR09tOEtDVUl4OU9VMDRtN3pVMWJDZWY1eXRBamRNUkVWT1NOeHZpdE52dUlFb1FINFRkcGxtU0x1UQ?oc=5).
